evidence_quote: A current validator can stop block production in the stated four-validator, London-only, zeroBaseFee IBFT configuration.
statement: A moderate-severity advisory (GHSA-6pcq-hcgg-5q76) published 2026-11-10 describes an IBFT 2.0 availability vulnerability in Hyperledger Besu versions <= 26.10.1, fixed in 26.10.2. The advisory explicitly limits its impact claim to that specific configuration and does not claim permanence, a same-height fork, fund impact, or QBFT impact.
